phases.name: Get the game ready
phases.blurb: Fixes, decisions and store material that live in the project.

phases.name: Open the accounts
phases.blurb: Developer accounts, payments, tax and identity checks. Only you can do these.

phases.name: Build for each store
phases.blurb: Signed, store-ready builds for every platform.

phases.name: Fill in the store pages
phases.blurb: Listings, ratings, privacy answers, art and screenshots in each store.

phases.name: Test with real players
phases.blurb: Test tracks, testers and bug fixing.

phases.name: Submit for review
phases.blurb: Send each build and page to the store for approval.

phases.name: Launch and keep it healthy
phases.blurb: Release, then watch reviews, crashes and ads.
